name: ebay-mcp
description: eBay (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing, set_inventory, list_orders. Every tool m

platform_mcp_ebay_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_EBAY_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_ebay_client_id.description: Production keyset App ID (Client ID) from developer.ebay.com > Application Keys; sent with the Cert ID as HTTP Basic on the token call.

platform_mcp_ebay_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_EBAY_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_ebay_refresh_token.description: User refresh token (v^1.1#...) from a one-time authorization-code consent that granted at least sell.inventory, sell.fulfillment and sell.account (the refresh request re-asks exactly these scopes, which must be a subset of the consent); long-lived (about 18 months), revoked when the seller changes password. 2-hour user access tokens are minted from it.

platform_mcp_ebay_currency.title: PLATFORM_MCP_EBAY_CURRENCY
platform_mcp_ebay_currency.description: Currency of your listings' marketplace (e.g. USD, GBP, EUR); needed only by update_listing, since eBay prices are {value, currency} objects.

platform_mcp_ebay_env.title: PLATFORM_MCP_EBAY_ENV
platform_mcp_ebay_env.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = https://api.sandbox.ebay.com. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

platform_mcp_ebay_base_url.title: PLATFORM_MCP_EBAY_BASE_URL
platform_mcp_ebay_base_url.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /sell/account/v1/privilege (scope sell.account) returns {sellerRegistrationCompleted, sellingLimit{amount, quantity}} for the seller the refresh token belongs to.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: POST /sell/inventory/v1/bulk_update_price_quantity {requests: [{offers: [{offerId, availableQuantity, price{value, currency}}]}]} revises price and/or quantity of one published offer (listing_id = the Inventory API offerId). price.value is sent as the documented decimal string and price.currency comes from the `currency` config field — pass `price` whenever currency is configured. `title`/`description` are not changed (they live on the inventory item, whose PUT replaces the whole record). eBay answers 200 with a per-offer statusCode and errors[] under responses[]: check raw.statusCode (200 = applied).

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: POST /sell/inventory/v1/offer/{offerId}/withdraw ends the single-variation listing of the offer; the offer object stays (unpublished) and can be republished. Returns {listingId, warnings}. deleteOffer is not used.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: POST /sell/inventory/v1/bulk_update_price_quantity {requests: [{sku, shipToLocationAvailability{quantity}}]} sets the inventory item's total ship-to-home quantity (flows to its published offers). `sku` is required (the Inventory API keys items by SKU; listing_id is not used). Per-item statusCode / errors come back 200 under responses[] (see raw).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: GET /sell/fulfillment/v1/order?limit(max 200, default 50)&offset (scope sell.fulfillment) returns {total, orders[{orderId, orderFulfillmentStatus NOT_STARTED|IN_PROGRESS|FULFILLED, pricingSummary.total{value, currency}, creationDate}]} for up to the last 2 years. `since` and `status` are ignored: eBay filters through one composed `filter` string (creationdate:[<ISO>..],orderfulfillmentstatus:{NOT_STARTED|IN_PROGRESS}) that the adapter cannot assemble. `total` is the decimal string eBay returns.
